rules.title: Algorithmic rent-pricing prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants may bring claims for damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month of use for each affected dwelling unit may be a separate violation

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to landlords using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
coverage.summary: Coverage is described only as landlords and affected dwelling units involving qualifying algorithmic rent or occupancy devices.

rules.penalty: Civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; each month of use for each affected dwelling unit may constitute a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Each month of use for each affected dwelling unit may constitute a separate violation, and tenants may seek damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation.

rules.title: Algorithmic rent-pricing prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords may not improperly use algorithmic rent-pricing products under San Diego’s similar prohibition. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief, and penalties.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month and affected rental property may be a separate violation

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to prohibited use of algorithmic rent-pricing products, with violations tied to each affected rental property and month.
coverage.summary: Coverage is described only as affected rental properties involving prohibited algorithmic rent-pricing use.

rules.penalty: Tenant suits may seek damages, injunctive relief, and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; each month and affected rental property may be a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.

rules.title: Coordinated pricing algorithms prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use coordinated pricing algorithms covered by the Berkeley ordinance. The ordinance treats violations as recurring by unit and month and provides private remedies.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to coordinated pricing algorithms; covered properties or tenancies are not further described.
coverage.summary: Coverage details are not stated beyond the use of coordinated pricing algorithms in rental housing.

rules.penalty: Private remedies; recurring unit/month violations are described, but the amount is not stated.
rules.quoted_span:
Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.63 (effective January 2026)
Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al.,

rules.effective_date_basis: Santa Ana Ordinance No. NS-3090 (effective April 2, 2026)
rules.title: Anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords may not engage in specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing covered by the ordinance. Tenants may bring private claims and seek penalties.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; covered properties or tenancies are not further described.
coverage.summary: Coverage details are not stated beyond specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing in rental housing.

rules.penalty: Private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.quoted_span:
Santa Ana Ordinance No. NS-3090 (effective April 2, 2026) 
Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.

rules.title: Algorithmic rent coordination services prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ordinance includes both public and private enforcement.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; covered properties or tenancies are not further described.
coverage.summary: Coverage details are not stated beyond landlords using algorithmic rent coordination services.

rules.penalty: Public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.quoted_span:
Jersey City Code § 218-12 (effective June 2025)
Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.

rules.title: Rent coordination software prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy. The document does not state the remedy or penalty.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to landlords using software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
coverage.summary: Coverage is described only as landlords using covered software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms.

rules.quoted_span:
Hoboken City Code, ch. 158-2 (effective July 2025)
Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
